propositions: The store-copy scrub removes .bridge_state* from the copied store but the artifact survives post-scrub into the isolation test assertion, failing test_the_store_copy_is_complete_and_scrubbed

The projects-seed ensure unit (added in commit 72731d3745) unconditionally re-creates .bridge_state/projects.json during run_ensures() convergence when git show fails, resurrecting the scrubbed artifact
The scrub runs before run_ensures() but the seed unit executes during convergence, causing an ordering regression where the post-scrub state is silently mutated back to pre-scrub
A re-scrub of .bridge_state* glob after run_ensures() completes (with commit) removes the resurrected artifact from both worktree and tickets tree
The fix preserves .env-id store marker created by run_ensures while removing all .bridge_state* artifacts via double-scrub pattern
